name: Indo Cotspin Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1955, Indo Cotspin Ltd is in the business of Non Woven Fabric/ Tufted Carpet manufacturing and trading of textile goods.
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1]
a) Non Woven:[2] Plain Carpets, Printed Carpets, Felt Carpets, Designer Carpets
b) Hand Tufted:[3] Shaggy, Woolen, Carpets
c) Door Mats:[4]
d) Geo Textiles:[5] Non Woven Geo Textiles, Non-Woven Fabrics

pros: Debtor days have improved from 25.0 to 18.7 days.
cons: Stock is trading at 2.69 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 2.10% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
